annualEvents.name: Grand National Festival
annualEvents.notes: 9.67km from Baltic Market. Hotel guest residual footfall only.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Sound City
annualEvents.notes: Multi-venue festival IN Baltic Triangle. Core venue IS Baltic Market. Biggest sales day of the year.

annualEvents.name: On The Waterfront
annualEvents.notes: 1.6km at Pier Head. Some spillover to Baltic for evening food.

annualEvents.name: Africa Oyé
annualEvents.notes: 3.53km at Sefton Park. Festival has own food stalls. Minimal cross-traffic.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool International Music Festival
annualEvents.notes: 3.53km at Sefton Park. Same as Africa Oyé.

annualEvents.name: River of Light
annualEvents.notes: Evening art trail in October. Cold weather = churro demand. Some drift to Baltic.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Christmas Market
annualEvents.notes: 1.71km. Christmas Market sells churros directly (COMPETITION). Some overall footfall benefit but reduced churro-specific impact.

annualEvents.name: Comic Con Liverpool
annualEvents.notes: 0.63km at M&S Bank Arena. Convention crowds seek nearby food. 7-min walk.

annualEvents.name: Rock 'n' Roll Marathon
annualEvents.notes: Runners want carb-heavy food post-race. Churros = fried dough carbs. Moderate synergy.

annualEvents.name: Mathew Street Festival
annualEvents.notes: 300k at Pier Head/Mathew St. Most stay at waterfront. Some drift south to Baltic.

annualEvents.name: LightNight Liverpool
annualEvents.notes: City-wide arts festival. Baltic Triangle galleries participate.

annualEvents.name: Brouhaha International Festival
annualEvents.notes: Street arts carnival. Includes Baltic Triangle area.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Pride
annualEvents.notes: Festival spreads city-wide. Some reach Baltic.

annualEvents.name: Giants Spectacular
annualEvents.notes: Parade route through city. Some may reach Baltic Triangle.

_meta.notes: classification: DIRECT (at/near Baltic Market), NEARBY (within ~2km), IRRELEVANT (too far). churroImpact is churro-stall-specific impact score (0.0-1.0).
